schema.title: Operations snapshot envelope and shared protocol definitions
schema.description: System owns health evaluation. Readers preserve optional fields and their existing unknown-field handling. Duration bounds distinguish producer emission from compatible reader acceptance.

x-compatibility.unknownHostsAndDevices: Readers display other for well-formed names added before their release; these are display subsets, not fleet membership.
x-compatibility.unknownFields: Admin records field names and skips malformed events while advancing readable sequence cursors. Mini status remains an exact bounded privacy projection.
x-compatibility.durationBounds: Run producers clamp to one hour; readers accept legacy or other run durations through one year. Access latency remains capped at one hour.

source_text:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:anipotts:system:ops:v1",
  "title": "Operations snapshot envelope and shared protocol definitions",
  "description": "System owns health evaluation. Readers preserve optional fields and their existing unknown-field handling. Duration bounds distinguish producer emission from compatible reader acceptance.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["version", "generated_at", "catalog", "status", "counts"],
  "properties": {
    "version": {"const": "ops_v1"},
    "generated_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"},
    "catalog": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}},
    "status": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}},
    "counts": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "$defs": {
    "state": {"enum": ["ok", "degraded", "failing", "stale", "asleep", "unknown"]},
    "kind": {"enum": ["job", "service", "host", "backup", "web"]},
    "trigger": {"type": "string", "enum": ["interval", "calendar", "keepalive", "watch", "manual", "sampled"], "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$"},
    "id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,63}$"},
    "host": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$"},
    "fieldName": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$"},
    "timestamp": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$"},
    "eventKind": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,31}$"},
    "route": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,39}$"},
    "eventsVersion": {"const": "ops_events_v1"}
  },
  "x-policy": {
    "snapshotReader": {
      "maxBytes": 65536,
      "maxEntries": 500,
      "nameMax": 120,
      "groupMax": 64,
      "detailMax": 160,
      "runbookMax": 512,
      "scheduleMax": 64,
      "budgetMaxSeconds": 31622400,
      "exitMin": -2147483648,
      "exitMax": 2147483647,
      "runsMax": 2147483647,
      "uptimeMaxSeconds": 316224000
    },
    "eventsReader": {
      "maxBytes": 524288,
      "maxLimit": 500,
      "maxSeq": 10000000000,
      "accessMs": 3600000,
      "readerRunMs": 31622400000,
      "subjectMax": 64
    },
    "producerRunMs": 3600000,
    "eventsPath": "/v1/ops/events",
    "eventsMaxWaitSeconds": 25
  },
  "x-shapes": {
    "catalogRequired": ["id", "name", "group", "kind", "host", "freshness_budget_s", "runbook", "schedule"],
    "catalogOptional": ["trigger"],
    "catalogIgnored": ["owner"],
    "statusRequired": ["id", "state", "detail", "last_success_at", "last_run_at", "last_exit"],
    "statusOptional": ["runs", "interval_s", "last_duration_s", "next_run_at"],
    "hostFields": ["disk_percent", "uptime_s", "awake"],
    "eventRequired": ["seq", "at", "kind", "subject", "from_state", "to_state", "status", "ms", "detail"],
    "eventOptional": ["device"],
    "eventRoot": ["version", "items", "next_after"]
  },
  "x-compatibility": {
    "knownHosts": ["ap-mini", "ap-pro", "cloudflare"],
    "knownDevices": ["ap-pro", "ap-phone", "ap-plus", "ap-mini", "loopback", "other"],
    "unknownHostsAndDevices": "Readers display other for well-formed names added before their release; these are display subsets, not fleet membership.",
    "unknownFields": "Admin records field names and skips malformed events while advancing readable sequence cursors. Mini status remains an exact bounded privacy projection.",
    "durationBounds": "Run producers clamp to one hour; readers accept legacy or other run durations through one year. Access latency remains capped at one hour."
  }
}
